brief: Single-lead ECG chest patch, 14-day continuous wear, sealed.

findings.title: Electrode leads exit far enough apart to resolve the lead vector
findings.explanation: ELEC_A and ELEC_B are only 6.00 mm apart, 35 mm required.
findings.rationale: A single-lead ECG measures the potential difference between two electrodes, and amplitude scales with how much of the heart's dipole the pair spans. The pads themselves are on flying leads and land wherever the adhesive puts them, so this checks the connectors as a proxy for where the leads exit the shell: connectors at the same end force the pads together too.
findings.limitation: Threshold declared in the submitted constraints, not derived.

findings.title: CELL is clear of heat source CHG
findings.explanation: CELL sits 6.95 mm from CHG (edge gap) but needs 8 mm. Short by 1.05 mm.
findings.rationale: Sustained heat accelerates lithium cell ageing and lowers the thermal runaway threshold. This cell sits directly against the skin-side shell with no convective path, so heat that reaches it stays there and reaches the patient.
findings.limitation: Distance threshold for cell ageing and runaway margin, not a solved cell temperature.
findings.suggested_action: Move CELL at least 1.05 mm further from CHG.

findings.title: ESD protection sits at the electrode entry, not downstream of it
findings.explanation: ESD and ELEC_A are 12.00 mm apart, exceeds the 10 mm maximum.
findings.rationale: Protection only works ahead of what it protects. If the clamp is further from the connector than the AFE is, a strike travels down board copper past the front end before it reaches the diode.
findings.limitation: Threshold declared in the submitted constraints, not derived.

findings.title: AFE is clear of noise source BUCK
findings.explanation: AFE sits 1.50 mm from BUCK (edge gap) but needs 15 mm. Short by 13.50 mm.
findings.rationale: The signal at the front end is roughly 1 mV. The buck's switching fundamental and its harmonics fall inside the 0-150 Hz band the AFE's noise figure is specified in, so coupled switching noise does not degrade the trace, it buries the QRS complex.
findings.limitation: Distance threshold, not a computed coupling coefficient.
findings.suggested_action: Move AFE at least 13.50 mm further from BUCK.

findings.title: AFE is clear of heat source BUCK
findings.explanation: AFE sits 1.50 mm from BUCK (edge gap) but needs 10 mm. Short by 8.50 mm.
findings.rationale: A 24-bit front end resolves well under a microvolt per count. Self-heating in a neighbouring part drifts its input offset and bias currents, and that drift reads as baseline wander that looks like respiration.
findings.limitation: Distance threshold, not a computed junction temperature.
findings.suggested_action: Move AFE at least 8.50 mm further from BUCK.

findings.title: AFE is clear of heat source CHG
findings.explanation: AFE sits 7.00 mm from CHG (edge gap) but needs 10 mm. Short by 3.00 mm.
findings.rationale: A 24-bit front end resolves well under a microvolt per count. Self-heating in a neighbouring part drifts its input offset and bias currents, and that drift reads as baseline wander that looks like respiration.
findings.limitation: Distance threshold, not a computed junction temperature.
findings.suggested_action: Move AFE at least 3.00 mm further from CHG.

findings.title: AFE is outside the BUCK heat zone
findings.explanation: AFE reaches 3.00 mm inside the 6 mm thermal zone around BUCK.
findings.rationale: A fixed radius standing in for the elevated-temperature region around a dissipating part. A geometric proxy, not a solved thermal field.
findings.limitation: Fixed radius standing in for the elevated-temperature region around a dissipating part. Not a solved thermal field.
findings.suggested_action: Move AFE 3.00 mm further from BUCK, or cut BUCK dissipation.

findings.title: AFE fits under the lid
findings.explanation: AFE stands 1 mm tall against a 6.5 mm ceiling (5.50 mm spare).
findings.rationale: Interior height 8.5 mm minus the 1 mm standoff and 1 mm board leaves 6.5 mm above the surface. The 5.6 mm cell sets the enclosure height, and the two top-entry connectors need vertical clearance to be mated during assembly. The patch has to stay wearable under a shirt, so every millimetre here is argued for.

findings.limitation: Distance threshold, not a computed link budget.

findings.title: BLE antenna keep-out is clear
findings.explanation: The 6 mm keep-out ahead of BLE is clear.
findings.rationale: The module's antenna radiates into the volume ahead of it. Copper or bulk material inside that volume detunes the match, and inside a sealed patch there is no way to retune after assembly.

findings.title: Patient connected spacing — not evaluated
findings.explanation: Creepage needs a path along an insulating surface and clearance needs separation through air. Neither is derivable from component outlines and centre distances, so no spacing verdict is issued.
findings.limitation: Creepage needs a path along an insulating surface and clearance needs separation through air. Neither is derivable from component outlines and centre distances, so no spacing verdict is issued.

findings.title: Radiated emissions — not evaluated
findings.explanation: Antenna keep-out is a rectangular exclusion volume, not a radiation pattern. No emissions level, link budget, or compliance margin is computed.
findings.limitation: Antenna keep-out is a rectangular exclusion volume, not a radiation pattern. No emissions level, link budget, or compliance margin is computed.

findings.title: Thermal field — not evaluated
findings.explanation: No thermal solve is performed. Heat is modelled as a declared radius around a dissipating part, so no surface or junction temperature is produced and none should be inferred from the zone overlays.
findings.limitation: No thermal solve is performed. Heat is modelled as a declared radius around a dissipating part, so no surface or junction temperature is produced and none should be inferred from the zone overlays.

findings.title: Trace current copper geometry — not evaluated
findings.explanation: No copper geometry or current data is carried in a submission. Traces are polylines used only for antenna keep-out crossing, so trace width against current cannot be evaluated.
findings.limitation: No copper geometry or current data is carried in a submission. Traces are polylines used only for antenna keep-out crossing, so trace width against current cannot be evaluated.
